Compose only compatible preconditions/effects/results/authority, preserving applicable outer obligations across decomposition/delegation/concurrency/recursion. Local success establishes end-to-end success only with coverage, compatibility and outcome evidence; chain obligations/categorical demonstrations retain FOUNDATIONS §4 ownership. Feedback follows observation/comparison/diagnosis/authorized response/action/reobservation; bugs use ordinary change intake/delivery. Diagnose defective realization, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate model or insufficient observation separately; prediction error proves no outcome, model revision erases no counterexample and repairs no realization by itself. Preserve unresolved alternatives; supported repair belongs to cause owner, labels grant no class/permission. Severity concerns consequence, priority orders under outcome/dependencies/resources/authority; bug lists create no separate mechanism. Preservation, evidence-based progress, termination and outcome satisfaction require distinct support; formal induction/termination claims give premises/argument but no universal termination proof is prerequisite to bounded work. Continuing work needs supported purpose, possibly uncertainty reduction/hypothesis testing; repetition alone is not progress. Failure/missing information/uncertain effects/exhaustion use owned continuation/repair/recovery/re-entry/yield/stop; resume reacquires reality, preserves valid progress and resolves effects sufficiently before dependent action. Maintenance may continue under mandate; delivery needs completion conditions. Core evaluation preserves failure, coverage gaps and uncertainty; proof/checking/testing/use establish only scoped claims and required unavailable proof remains owed. Candidate, property proof and accepted delivery are separate. Completion needs sufficient Z evidence; exhaustion proves neither achievement nor impossibility, and changing Z leaves former counterexamples intact. Existing carriers suffice; relation adds no ledger, role sequence, runtime, general solver, fixed organization, convergence guarantee or categorical-universality theorem. Domain strategy/configuration/mechanisms/additional assurance retain their owners.

AS-5: where human/probabilistic checker soundly admits satisfied or indeterminate on identical observations, the model admits both; universal soundness covers all admitted conclusions, deterministic selection keeps scope, probability needs distribution/evidence (FOUNDATIONS §4 assertions). AS-6: differing actors agreeing through shared wrong interpretation/fixture/contribution do not supply independence; expose common causes and port authorship, and validate common expectation using its separate purpose/evidence (FOUNDATIONS §4 parallel derivation; AR-03).

Universal soundness covers every admitted conclusion, not a favourable run. Always deciding q_t correctly from π alone requires equal observations to imply equal q_t truth for every pair in Ω. Observationally identical cases of opposite truth require more evidence, justified narrower scope or indeterminate. The classical image predicate entails neither an executable procedure nor a cost. Instrument, actor or execution acquisition needs supported observation binding; an idealised π does not establish it. Until oracle fidelity is established, reported passes and failures remain observations, not established source-obligation satisfaction or falsification. A relation supplies no probabilities; probabilistic claims need their declared outcome distribution. Unknown effects, unavailable observations, non-performance and unresolved work/coverage remain distinct from falsehood and indeterminate judgments.

For every selected derived context, missing/ambiguous/changed/unavailable program, map or source evidence holds the whole update before consumer effects. Only the source owner performs semantic re-entry; the manager cannot relabel old maps current. Source freshness proves integrity, not semantic conformance/verdict. After staging, recheck consumer preimages and source evidence; report completion only after verifying every selected resulting binding/companion. Pre-effect refusal retains prior state; caught application failure restores affected preimages and reports no completion. Application requires exclusive consumer write scope. No cross-path crash atomicity is claimed; process/host loss or unavailable rollback requires preimage recovery before claiming the complete relation.

For 'intended effect occurred', completed→satisfied requires evidence of the entire effect. Refusal before any effect with retained prior-state evidence is not_effected→falsified and ended. Caught application failure is also not_effected→falsified: the complete update fell short and no later part is applied, regardless of rollback verification. Verified restoration establishes the effect's end; unverified restoration or unavailable rollback leaves the end unestablished, recorded as a residual naming needed verification without changing falsified. Name unused newly staged installs as the part that did occur. Abrupt process/host loss without a caught failure establishing shortfall yields completion_unknown→indeterminate, never completed or not_effected. Reconcile unknown completion or unestablished end from presented preimages before repetition or complete-relation claims.

Independent review is required at product, qualification, release and explicitly risk-bearing boundaries claiming it. Required reviews identify exact subject/basis/scope/exclusions/evidence/verdict/unresolved findings, and findings cite current authority plus code/proof paths rather than historical commentary alone. Human acceptance/rejection cannot make self-review independent. Claimed review supports promotion/closure only with durable exact subject/verdict traceability in existing ticket/commentary/qualification/release evidence; occurrence statements, unbound summaries and unavailable drafts are not verdicts. Verdicts stay within exact claim/hard stops; external EVALUATION §5 owns blocking findings and no trigger is added here. Where agentic construction applies, active work identifies selected basis, bounded affected relations, delegated construction/assessment authority and re-entry; references to existing design/evidence may suffice. Ticket state/prose/admitted contract cannot widen basis or replace required live-surface assessment. Every relation is an exact inherited TypedRelation; the table omits no inherited fields. OccurrenceRelationQualifiers has exactly nine fields: cardinality, authority_ref, evidence_refs, provenance_refs, invalidation_ref, inverse_kind_ref_or_none, preservation, loss, refusal. Closed enum domains: cardinality={exactly_one,zero_or_one,zero_or_more,one_or_more}; preservation={identity_preserved,meaning_preserved,not_applicable}; loss={none,declared_loss}; refusal={refuse_missing,refuse_duplicate,refuse_wrong_type,refuse_invalid_basis,refuse_out_of_scope,not_applicable}. Every core relation fixes preservation=meaning_preserved, loss=none, inverse_kind_ref_or_none=none, refusal to one of the five refuse_* values, and cardinality to its exact kind's contract. not_applicable is unavailable to core relations. Five identity-bearing fields resolve through the finite reference table; authority/evidence/provenance/invalidation are exact instance coordinates. Missing/extra fields, duplicate refs, unknown enums, kind/cardinality mismatch, incompatible preservation, declared loss, non-null inverse, unavailable refusal, unresolved qualifier refs or qualifier basis mismatch refuse structural admission. Materialization copies accepted qualifiers byte for byte; silence implies no inverse.
